name: temu.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 page has no title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.
summary: www.temu.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: 1 page has no title.

fix.title: 1 page has no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 19 elements on /, /about-temu.html, for example div[data-tooltip="goodContainer-607201620004812"] > ._35MtXLKS.JuOSqoaD > ._2smoWAUE._1XWuIfqs._2wQVZs2Q > ._3WBDHjhZ[da and div[data-tooltip="goodContainer-607201620004812"] >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 74 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /shipping-info.html, /temu-purchase-protection.html, /how-to-order.html, /how-to-track.html and 70 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 3 titles are shared by more than one page
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /shopping_category.html, /about-temu.html, for example ._1GlrHM1T and ._3cCv2OHw[rel="nofollow noreferrer"][target="_blank"]:nth-child(1). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /submit-feedback.html?refer_page_el_sn=3001. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 406 ms
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
